items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went with Joe Venuti, immediately when I got out of high school I was with Joe Venuti

ctx.x: And then you went on to music studies at a couple major places right?
No, I didn’t I went right on the road with bands, I went with Joe Venuti, immediately when I got out of high school I was with Joe Venuti, I mean immediately.
